assertions: The response routes the request to the drugcomb sub-skill, not drugcombdb.
The response uses a case-insensitive substring match on drug_row/drug_col for the drug name 5-FU and on cell_line_name for MCF-7, per the drugcomb SKILL.md pattern table.
The response uses the drugcomb search/summarize API (search(data, entity) and summarize(hits, entity)) and reports synergy_zip and synergy_bliss columns.
The response references the DrugComb key columns drug_row, drug_col, cell_line_name, synergy_zip, synergy_bliss.
The response does not use the DrugCombDB columns (Drug1, Drug2, Cell, Synergy, SynergyType, PMID).
